hypotheses: Owner: preferences may be lost in history and recovered by replay/correction.
competing_predictions: No difference, opposite direction, length/recency/instruction effects; no inference about internal memory.
outcomes: Target base-plus correctness, raw tokens/native timings, qualified generation-only CPU-package energy; E5 format adherence; R2 cross-pass.
analysis: Pilot diagnostic only. Paired task-bootstrap2000/seed1732, 95% percentile intervals. Buried-immediate and replayed-buried plain-code adherence, each model; Holm family4. Correctness, corrected-immediate and no-preference comparisons secondary.
exclusions: Pilot separate; invalid input/API/infrastructure disclosed; caps bounded nonpass, not giving up; missing energy no imputation; drift and low-resolution sensitivities. R2 material exclusions frozen before generation, never selected by model outcome.
interpretation_changers: Oracle/reference or classifier errors, incomplete distinguishing cases, censoring, input length/position differences, drift and benchmark contamination.
inference_boundary: Two small Q4_K_M models, one fixed benchmark roster, one sample per task-cell. Custom distractor suites are not a new validated benchmark.
